name: Kyonyuu Hitozuma Kyoushi ~Chijoku no Kounai Choukyou~
original_name: 巨乳人妻教師 ～恥辱の校内調教～
source:
A high school student finally gets enough gumption to confess his feelings to his homeroom teacher. However, as usual for him, he’s rejected by yet another woman. It would appear that this latest letdown was to be the last straw. Soon he begins plotting a way to bind the poor woman to his will. His plan will soon succeed, and soon there will be a mix of shame, sex, and slave-making within the hallways and classrooms of the campus. Oh, and somehow the school nurse gets caught up in it too.

[Vague Game Description by White Masq]
translation:
一名高中生终于鼓起勇气向班主任坦白了自己的感受。然而，和往常一样，他又被另一个女人拒绝了。看来，最近的这次失望将成为最后一根稻草。很快，他开始策划一种方法，让这个可怜的女人服从他的意志。他的计划很快就会成功，很快校园的走廊和教室里就会出现羞耻、性和奴役的混合体。哦，不知何故，学校护士也被卷入其中。

[White Masq的模糊游戏描述]
